subject: Inference operations: validation plan + observability POC next steps
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Li <alex.li@peakcloud.ai>, Priya Nair <priya@peakcloud.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Inference operations: validation plan + observability POC next steps

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciated the clarity on PeakCloud's latency targets (p95 < 120ms for 512-token jobs) and the need for end-to-end visibility across billing/usage, traces, and per-model token breakdowns. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

1) Goals we heard
- Performance: p95 latency <= 120ms for 512 tokens, target throughput 200 concurrent requests.
- Cost: unit economics comparison vs your current hyperscaler endpoints.
- Observability: need token-level cost attribution, request traces that link to model variant, and dashboarding for top customers.

2) Proof-of-concept scope we propose (3-week focused POC)
- Week 0: Baseline capture — run synthetic suite (we'll provide the regen load tests) against your current endpoints and Redwood test cluster.
- Week 1: Observability integration — enable our tracing hooks, prefix cache metrics, and per-route cost breakdown in the Redwood Console.
- Week 2: Comparative validation — run identical load against your hyperscaler setup and our dedicated config; capture p95/p99, cost per 1k tokens, and cold-start variance.

3) Data & security asks from PeakCloud
- SOC2 summary and retention window for logs (see attached).
- Any IP restrictions for the test payloads; if needed we can run the POC in your VPC private endpoint.

4) Owners / timeline
- Redwood: Neha (POC coordination), Rishi (infra/test config), Marissa (observability instrumentation).
- PeakCloud: Alex (technical lead), Priya (procurement/contracting).

Attachments: rinf-observability-matrix.pdf (what we'll measure), poe-test-plan.xlsx (test harness + scripts), soc2-summary.pdf

Proposed immediate actions:
- Alex / Priya: confirm the three-week window or suggest constraints.
- If you want a VPC POC, flag that now and we'll loop in Private deployment team (this adds ~5 business days to access).

I'll schedule a 30m sync for Monday to kick off unless you prefer a different cadence.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199

--
Redwood Inference | Production-first inference runtime

From: Alex Li <alex.li@peakcloud.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya@peakcloud.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Inference operations: validation plan + observability POC next steps

Thanks Neha — this looks good and aligns with what we discussed. A few quick notes from the PeakCloud side: 

- We can do the 3-week window starting Aug 24. Our infra team needs the test scripts ahead of time so they can open firewall rules; send those by EOD next Tue.
- SOC2 summary received — we'll share a short list of additional evidence items (audit log retention, KMS integration notes).
- For security, prefer the VPC/private endpoint for customer data runs; happy to use synthetic payloads on public endpoints for the initial benchmarks.

Two asks: can Redwood provide a short checklist of observability signals you'll surface (span IDs, token-count per request, batch metrics, KV-cache hit rates)? Also we need a simple cost model — for our procurement team to reason about savings vs hyperscaler.

Alex
Principal Architect, PeakCloud
alex.li@peakcloud.ai

On Tue, Aug 11, 2026 at 2:02 PM Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai> wrote:
> (original message)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Li <alex.li@peakcloud.ai>, Priya Nair <priya@peakcloud.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Inference operations: validation plan + observability POC next steps

Alex — thanks, great questions. Quick answers inline and attached an observability signal checklist: rinf-observability-matrix.pdf.

- Signals we'll surface (summary):
  • Request-level span IDs + parent-child relationship to map frontend -> inference runtime.
  • Token_count per request + per-response token attribution.
  • Per-model and per-variant latency histograms (p50/p95/p99) and cold-start flags.
  • Batch size distribution and batch latency contribution.
  • KV cache hit/miss rates and effective token reduction metric.
  • Cost attribution: tokens * model_unit_cost + infra amortized cost (we provide a baseline model).

- Cost model: attached POE (poe-test-plan.xlsx) includes a cost worksheet. Short summary: for 512-token median requests, our dedicated configs target ~35-50% lower token+GPU cost compared to managed hyperscaler endpoints because of continuous batching and KV prefix caching; exact numbers will depend on your concurrency and sequence-length distribution. We'll produce a tailored delta for PeakCloud after baseline runs.

Next steps I propose for this week:
- Rishi: can you push the synthetic harness and a dockerized load generator to the shared link by Friday?
- Marissa: schedule a 45m instrumentation walkthrough with Alex's infra team (call owner: Marissa).
- Alex/Priya: confirm Aug 24 start and whether you want VPC from day 1.

If it's helpful, Sergio can prepare a short one-pager comparing our observability surface to the top hyperscalers — I'll ask him to highlight where we provide per-token cost attribution and request-level tracing out of the box.

Neha

From: Priya Nair <priya@peakcloud.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Alex Li <alex.li@peakcloud.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Aug 2026 09:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Inference operations: validation plan + observability POC next steps

Hi team — we can confirm the Aug 24 start. A few procurement/contract notes so we don't get blocked later: 

- We'll need a short commercial term (PO required) and an NDA addendum for the VPC trial. Please send a one-page trial agreement and an indicative price sheet for the three-week POC; we don't need final pricing but want a ballpark.
- Alex will accept synthetic payloads on public endpoints for weeks 0-1; for weeks 2-3 we'll want the VPC option enabled. If the VPC takes >5 business days, we can run the comparative validation against a dedicated tenant instead.

Action items before Aug 24:
- Redwood: one-page trial agreement + indicative pricing (Sergio, can you take lead?)
- Redwood: load harness and instrumentation walkthrough (Rishi/Marissa)
- PeakCloud: share minimal list of SOC2 evidence items (we'll send that today)

Thanks,
Priya Nair
